canonical_project: Digital Realty / Interxion MRS campus Marseille (MRS1-MRS5)
notes: Marseille port-area campus (Enceinte Portuaire): MRS1-MRS3 operational (MRS3 opened as Interxion's third; MRS1/MRS2 ex-SFR Netcentre), MRS4 under construction (~13.6 MW expected, N+1 UPS/gen, 2N cooling), MRS5 construction finishing along the A55 grand port maritime as of Aug 2026 (La Marseillaise). Environmental-authorization record on projets-environnement.gouv.fr for MRS4 + substation (A-grade file). Capacity figure is MRS4 only; campus total higher.
